assertions.detail: getForegroundInfo, getGpuSchedulingPriority, getPidFromSourceId, getScreenRectFromDeviceIndex, getWindowExe, getWindowInfo, hdrCaptureRelease, hdrCaptureStart, hdrCaptureStats, hdrCaptureStop, hdrGetDisplays, isSupported, listApps, placeOverlayAbove, setGpuSchedulingPriority, setProcessPowerThrottling, setTimerResolution, startCapture, stopCapture

assertions.name: isSupported() is true with a PipeWire daemon, a session manager and a sink
S1  the list shows A (paplay, program pacat) and B (pw-cat)
S1  the list does NOT show "self" (a child of the excluded pid), by name or program
S1  exactly the two foreign applications, once each (de-duplicated)
S1  what the renderer gets is {handle, name, binary} - no key, no pid
S1  the raw addon list has a stream count per application
S1  the same app keeps the same handle on the next list
S2 include A  the start is authorized (issued handle + live window share grant)
S2 include A  440 Hz (pacat) is captured
S2 include A  1000 Hz (B) is absent
S2 include A  2000 Hz (self) is absent
S2 include A  stopCapture() removes our node and its links
assertions.detail: pw-dump has no cipherline-share-audio after stop

assertions.name: S3 include B  the start is authorized (issued handle + live window share grant)
S3 include B  1000 Hz (pw-cat) is captured
S3 include B  440 Hz (A) is absent
S3 include B  2000 Hz (self) is absent
S3 include B  stopCapture() removes our node and its links
assertions.detail: pw-dump has no cipherline-share-audio after stop

assertions.name: S4  start authorized
S4  before the restart: A (440 Hz) is captured
S4  A's NEW stream after the restart is re-linked: 440 Hz is back
S4  B and self stay out, before and after
S4  a restart that is quick is NOT reported as the app quitting
S5  a handle for an app that has gone quiet still starts a capture
S5  a stream that appears AFTER the capture started is picked up (440 Hz)
S5  while another app (B) plays, it stays out (1000 Hz absent)
S6  the app quitting is reported as { processExited } within ~4 s
S6  B (still playing) does not keep A alive
S7  asking for our own player's key captures nothing of it (2000 Hz absent)
S7  NEGATIVE CONTROL: the same key with another "own" pid DOES capture 2000 Hz
S7  a missing or empty key captures nothing
S8  forged: a handle main did not issue is refused
S8  rawKey: a handle main did not issue is refused
S8  aPid: a handle main did not issue is refused
S8  aBinaryName: a handle main did not issue is refused
S8  otherWindow: a handle main did not issue is refused
S8  no share grant: refused (consent)
S8  the real handle + the (unburned) grant still starts
S8  and it captures A only
S8  the same grant cannot start a second capture
S8  a SCREEN share's grant does not start an app capture
S8  an unstarted handle expires
S8  a started handle runs out SHARE_GAP_MS after its share ends
S9  the addon's debug output exists (positive control) ...
S9  ... and carries no application name, program name or pid of anything
assertions.detail: checked for paplay / pacat / pw-cat / selfplay / bash

S10 25 list + start/stop cycles do not crash or leak descriptors
